design.note: Every cell below shares the SAME episode set (Ruling 6) -- the matched-coverage contrast is within-episode, not a cross-sample comparison.

preregistered_exclusions.rationale: fit_match == 'earlier_session' (n=19 episodes / 77 selections in the full pool) is ANTI-predictive: mean score_top gap for correct vs wrong selections is -0.0473, versus +0.0275 (own_session_own_condition) and +0.0565 (own_session_other_condition). Pooling it into calibration or risk-coverage reporting degrades the apparent gate quality rather than flattering it. Excluded from the PRIMARY analysis; included in a required sensitivity analysis. Decided before any model call, per Ruling 23.

variance_substudy.note: Repetitions estimate model stochasticity only, not independent neural observations.

model_panel.note: One vendor each, all current-generation. Every model runs every LLM cell -- there is no core/panel split, so every between-arm contrast is within-model as well as within-episode.
model_panel.projection_basis: openai/gpt-5.6-luna, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, google/gemini-3.7-flash, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash: projected_usd_per_episode is MEASURED cost from a completed pilot (see commit a66a649), carried forward automatically from the prior manifest rather than recomputed from OBSERVED_PROMPT/COMPLETION_TOKENS below -- that naive formula was wrong for every one of these models. projected_usd_per_episode_original keeps the naive value for reference. Every other model below has no pilot data yet and uses the naive formula.

model_panel_at_principal_run.note: THE PANEL THAT PRODUCED THE PUBLISHED MANUSCRIPT'S NUMBERS. Every principal-run figure the manuscript reports came from these five models: 13_principal_run.py, 19_naturalistic_run.py, 14_confirmation_run.py, 15_repeat_run.py and 18_recalibrated_run.py all ran this panel and nothing else. `model_panel` above is the CURRENT panel and holds ten: it was expanded on 2026-09-09 (Task 5 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-09-semantic-fair-comparison-experiment.md) by editing 05b_panel.py, and the five added models (x-ai/grok-4.6, qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902, moonshotai/kimi-k3, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning, mistralai/mistral-medium-3-5) were used by ONE experiment only, 25_semantic_fair_comparison.py, whose own frozen manifest output/tables/semantic_fair_comparison_manifest.json records the ten-model panel it declared as `model_panel_at_declaration`.
model_panel_at_principal_run.reproduction_note: Those five runners read `model_panel.models` LIVE at run time, so re-running any of them today would issue requests for all ten models and produce numbers the manuscript does not report. To reproduce the published runs, pass `--models openai/gpt-5.6-luna,anthropic/claude-sonnet-5,google/gemini-3.7-flash,z-ai/glm-5.3-flash,deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` -- every one of the five scripts accepts that flag and validates it against the manifest panel. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 additionally ran on the frozen 500-episode subset recorded in principal_run.model_episode_subsets, not on all 1065 episodes.
model_panel_at_principal_run.recorded_because: The panel expansion left this manifest unable to say which models produced the published numbers: `model_panel.n_models` read 10 while `principal_run.budget.basis` still read 'over the 5-model panel', and nothing named the five. This block is that record. It is written by hand, not by 05b_panel.py, and no script overwrites it.

main_run.status: HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED -- NOT A RECORD OF ANYTHING THAT RAN. This block is 05b_panel.py's own projection of a full-factorial design (every panel model x every LLM cell x n_episodes_per_cell episodes) that was never executed. Its figures are recomputed from the CURRENT panel size on every run of that script, so `episode_runs.total` reads 32000 under today's 10-model panel and read 16000 under the five-model panel that produced the manuscript -- neither number counts an episode that was run, and neither appears in the paper. What actually ran, and what the manuscript reports, is in `principal_run`: 6 cells over 1065 episodes on the five models recorded in `model_panel_at_principal_run`, with anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 on a frozen 500-episode subset. `projected_cost_usd` here is stale for the same reason -- see `budget_note`.

episode_runs.note: every model runs every LLM cell, the 12 caution wordings included -- there is no separate battery

projected_cost_usd.basis: measured 2230 prompt / 104 completion tokens per episode (output/tables/cost_probe.json), no cache discount assumed

budget_note: HUMAN-SET hard ceiling $120.00 (raised from $115.00 2026-09-10, user-authorized, because Task 6's real paid run is measuring per-episode costs 1.16x-1.78x above this manifest's naive projections on several models -- kimi-k3 worst at 1.78x -- leaving too little margin to guarantee claude-sonnet-5, the most expensive and last-run model, completes before the ceiling bites; see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-09-semantic-fair-comparison-experiment.md Task 6). Prior raise: $100.00 -> $115.00 on 2026-09-09, to fund the semantic fair-comparison experiment plus an expanded model panel (Task 5/6). $99.1576 spent as of the 2026-09-10 flag that prompted this raise (recomputed via the same global meter 18_recalibrated_run.py:spent_so_far uses), leaving ~$20.84 of headroom against a revised ~$13.65 remaining-work estimate using OBSERVED cost multipliers, not the stale per-episode projections below. The $107.46 projected_cost_usd.total in main_run above is NOT Task 6's planned run -- it is this script's own stale, no-longer-executed 32-cell x 100-episode x 10-model full-factorial design (superseded first by the Option D 500-episode Sonnet subset, and now by the much smaller semantic fair-comparison design: 3 LLM arms x 10 models x 200 shared episodes). Task 6 must compute its own projection from its smoke test and observed run costs, not these figures, before spending. The runner must abort when cumulative observed `usage.cost` reaches this ceiling.

principal_run.rationale: s0 is the canonical frozen scaffold, declared before this run and chosen because it is the first-listed rendering in the frozen prompt bank, not because of its performance in the 100-episode exploratory factorial.
principal_run.declared_at_commit_note: A commit cannot record its own hash. This field is null in the commit that adds this block and is set to that commit's SHA by the very next commit (--fill-commit-sha) -- both land in git history before any request is issued, which is what makes the declaration checkable rather than merely asserted.

episode_set.selection_rule: nag.design.build_episode_pool() minus episodes whose fit_match == 'earlier_session' (Ruling 23's pre-specified primary-analysis exclusion)

budget.basis: sum of model_panel.models[].projected_usd_per_episode over the 5-model panel AS IT STOOD ON 2026-08-30 -- the five slugs are now recorded explicitly in `model_panel_at_principal_run`, because `model_panel` has since been expanded to ten and no longer describes this run, times 4 paid cells (oracle + 3 factorial-base cells; nonllm_gate and random_gate issue zero requests by construction and are excluded), times 1065 primary-eligible episodes `manifest_budget_usd` above is likewise the ceiling in force at the time of this run ($100.00); it was raised to $115.00 on 2026-09-09 and to $120.00 on 2026-09-10, and the top-level `budget_usd` carries the current one.

anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.reason: Measured cost for this model was 1.59x the manifest projection, so the approved plan did not fit the $100 ceiling. The shortfall is paid in precision on this model rather than by dropping an experiment or a model.
